verdict.rationale: CSC's entity-management platform includes AI document features and API integrations, so an MCP-client capability is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume external MCP servers. APIs, prebuilt integrations, and AI summarization are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
